retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: the seismic crisis of February 1964 destroyed most of the housing in the west of São Jorge in the Azores and about 5,000 people were evacuated to Terceira, Pico and Faial. A disaster with no consequence the atlas holds — the brief names these as expected retractions.
